turns.content: I got an offer from a smaller company. More responsibility, slightly less pay, and my current job is fine but I have been bored for a year. I have to answer by Friday and I keep flip-flopping every few hours.
You want more responsibility. You know your current job is boring. You do not want to be bored. What you want is clear. You will take the new offer.
My manager hinted there might be a promotion next cycle, but she hinted the same thing last year and nothing happened.
You already know your manager's hints are not true. You want a change now. You will take the new offer.
I made a pros and cons list and the lists are basically tied. That made it worse somehow.
Your list is even, but you already know what you want. You want more responsibility. You will do what you want.
Friday is tomorrow. I need to send one of the two emails in the morning.
You will send the email accepting the new offer. That is what you want to do.
